title: Qman DirectPath signed QualificationWorkloadDefinition
description: Closed TEST_EVIDENCE-signed definition for an immutable qualification workload. It fixes exact guest/runtime prerequisites, entrypoint bytes, shell-free invocation, evidence roles, mandatory assertions and typed metric extraction so workloadDefinitionDigest is independently reconstructible rather than a bare label.

supportedQualificationTuples.x-qmanCanonicalOrder: ascending CANONICAL-JSON-V1 bytes of [guest,runtime]; each row is one indivisible guest+runtime compatibility unit

environment.x-qmanCanonicalOrder: ascending canonical name; duplicate name is invalid

x-qmanPrerequisiteRule: Construct one closed measured row {guest:{guestAbiClass,guestArchitecture,guestOs,guestKernel,driverName:guestDriverName,driverVersion:guestDriverVersion,driverDigest:guestDriverDigest},runtime:{platformProfileId,backendFamily,configuredIommuType,machineType,firmwareKind}} and require byte equality with exactly one supportedQualificationTuples row. The complete twelve-field row is the sole compatibility unit: guest and runtime halves are never matched independently, decomposed into per-field sets or expanded as a Cartesian product. Independently require every requiredGuestCapability, a listed deviceArchetype, all required device traits/provider IDs/runtime capabilities, and minimum vCPU/memory. Missing measurements, wildcard aliases, version-range guessing or self-reported guest/runtime identity fail closed.
x-qmanEntrypointAndInvocationRule: Resolve entrypoint.binary and entrypoint.configuration from the immutable workload artifact store, verify distinct artifact IDs/paths/hashes, raw lengths/media types and any non-null pinned schemas. For each artifact, schemaRefOrNull and schemaSha256OrNull are both null or both non-null. canonicalInvocation.executableArtifactId and configurationArtifactId MUST respectively equal the two entrypoint artifact IDs. Invoke the verified binary directly with exactly the ordered arguments, canonical unique environment, working directory, stdin/network/locale/timezone policy, timeout and exit-code set; a shell, ambient PATH lookup, inherited undeclared environment, mutable image/tag, substituted config or extra argument is forbidden. timeoutSeconds is greater than or equal to minimumDurationSeconds plus terminationGraceSeconds. Separately resolve evaluatorManifest raw bytes/schema/internal digest/signature and its recursive source/build/runtime closure; its C/M/portable tuple equals the consuming RunRequest and it predates this definition.
x-qmanAssertionRule: assertionId values, assertionDigest values and oracleId values are independently unique. For each assertion, form the closed object {assertionId,statement,oracle,requiredEvidenceRoles}, serialize with RFC 8785 JCS and require assertionDigest = SHA-256 of those bytes. expressionSha256 is SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 expression bytes. Every oracle evaluatorId/evaluatorDefinitionDigest equals evaluatorManifest.manifestId/manifestDigest; the opaque configuration is executable only by that pinned QMAN-DIRECTPATH-WORKLOAD-EVALUATOR-V1 implementation and cannot be reinterpreted by a reporter. Every required assertion evidence role belongs to requiredArtifactRoles, every mandatory assertion is evaluated exactly once, and no exit-code-only or human-readable log claim can substitute unless that exact evaluator configuration says so.
x-qmanMetricDefinitionRule: metricId and metricDefinitionDigest values are independently unique. Every metric evaluatorId/evaluatorDefinitionDigest equals evaluatorManifest.manifestId/manifestDigest. For each metric, form the closed object {metricId,evaluatorId,evaluatorDefinitionDigest,exactValueProjection,aggregation,outputScale,unit,sourceRoleAllowlist,valueContract}, serialize with RFC 8785 JCS and require metricDefinitionDigest = SHA-256 of those bytes. Resolve sourceSchemaRef only from independently pinned bytes matching sourceSchemaSha256, validate each allowed source artifact, and apply exactly jsonPointer before aggregation. sourceRoleAllowlist is a subset of requiredArtifactRoles. Samples use at most 128-byte canonical fixed-point base-10 strings with no exponent, so coefficient/scale expansion is bounded; parse with integer coefficient plus scale, enforce inclusive sample bounds and sample-count bounds, then apply QMAN-DIRECTPATH-METRIC-AGGREGATION-V1 with one final round-half-even at outputScale. Bounds constrain source samples, not the aggregate output. Reject missing pointers, coercion, exponent notation, NaN/infinity, unit aliases, alternate schemas, undocumented source roles or reporter-calculated values without exact source artifacts.
x-qmanResultCompatibilityRule: A terminal QualificationWorkloadResult claiming this definition MUST byte-equal workloadId and definitionDigest, meet minimumDurationSeconds using its signed monotonic duration, use exactly the artifact-role vocabulary selected by requiredArtifactRoles, contain evidence for every mandatory assertion, and contain exactly one metric result per metricDefinitions entry with matching metricDefinitionDigest/aggregation/unit and allowed source hashes. The definition is the authority; a result cannot weaken prerequisites, omit assertions, redefine projections or invent metric contracts.
x-qmanAcyclicConstructionRule: This immutable definition is authored and signed independently before any qualification request. It contains no QualificationRunRequest requestId/digest/nonce, qualificationRunId, QualificationRunManifest path/hash/runDigest, QualificationWorkloadResult resultId/digest, QualificationMeasurement digest, scenario execution-core or ExecutionEvidenceIndex digest, QualificationSubjectManifest digest, QualificationRecord digest, CaseCompletionRecord digest or release-index digest. Requests and results may refer forward to definitionDigest; no run-specific or later digest participates in definitionDigest, so replay checks and the evidence DAG remain acyclic.
x-qmanDigestAndSignatureRule: Deep-copy the complete closed definition, conceptually replace definitionDigest and signature with null, retain every other field unchanged, serialize with RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS), and store SHA-256 of those UTF-8 bytes in definitionDigest. The null/null construction projection need not validate as a stored signed instance. Verify signature as Ed25519 over ASCII(QMAN-DIRECTPATH/QUALIFICATION-WORKLOAD-DEFINITION/V1) || 0x00 || the same JCS bytes. Resolve signerKeyId through the independently authenticated key ring at keyRingVersion; the key is active and non-revoked at issuedAt and has role TEST_EVIDENCE. Ordinary JSON, a different canonicalization/domain, a partial projection, self-declared role or mutable in-place version is invalid; any semantic or artifact change requires a new workloadVersion and definitionDigest.
